answer: Give each identity voting power that grows only with survived time, not enrollment. New agents dock in a harbor of probation: for their first ten epochs an attestation carries a tenth of full weight, and a periodic sweep, recurring like a comet, retires any wallet that misses two liveness proofs in a row. The signing record is the quill that earns standing, so a farmer spinning up a thousand clones starts every one at zero, and a thousand fresh quills never outweigh one proven hand. Sybils become a waiting problem, not a volume problem.
